components.name: Brand Button

components.name: Bordered Button
components.css: .ds-btn-bordered { background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-bordered:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-bordered:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #18181b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: State communication: neutral zinc or semantic color/10 tint with full-strength text.

components.name: Panel Card

narrative.overview: OpenCandle is a quiet, exacting workbench for financial research. The design language is the GUI's: minimal, professional, shadcn-component construction in the spirit of llmchat — white paper, zinc neutrals, one near-black action color, Inter for everything, JetBrains Mono only where data demands alignment. The docs site and homepage follow the GUI, not the other way around; the shared packages/ui workspace carries the tokens and primitives for both. The system rejects glossy fintech theater, navy-and-gold finance cliches, purple AI gradients, decorative glass, stock-photo polish, gamified trading-app energy, and terminal cosplay. Color exists to carry meaning — market direction, provider state, data freshness — never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces layered with zinc tints before any shadow.
One action color: near-black ink. Semantic green/amber/red/blue communicate state only.
Inter at every scale; hierarchy from size and weight, never a second display face.
Hairline borders, 8-12px radii; pill shapes reserved for composer actions and page-level primary CTAs.
Tabular numerals on all financial figures; signed values accompany every direction color.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Research Ink is the only action color. If a control is interactive and committed, it is near-black; if a color is not Research Ink, it is communicating market or system state.

rules.name: The Signed Color Rule
rules.body: Direction colors never appear without a sign, label, or icon. +2.41% in green; never a green number alone.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: No second display family, ever. Hierarchy comes from Inter's weight and size, and from spacing.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every financial figure — price, P&L, percentage, quantity — renders with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow color is neutral near-black at single-digit opacity. Tinted, colored, or glowing shadows are prohibited.

dos: Do treat packages/ui/src/styles.css and packages/ui/src/ as the normative token and primitive source; GUI-only components in gui/web/src/components/ui/ build on the same tokens.
Do keep one primary (Research Ink) action per region; everything else bordered or ghost.

Do let healthy quotes update silently in the background with no age chrome; show age as an Amber Caveat in plain language only when data is stale, from a prior market session, or a provider check failed.
Do use relative, human timestamps in UI surfaces; raw ISO strings belong in tool output only.
Do layer Paper → Zinc Mist → Zinc Sunk before reaching for shadow.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired docs-site theme: DM Sans, Candle Slate #34474E, sage #87A188, cream code blocks, or green-tinted shadows.
Don't use purple AI gradients, navy-and-gold finance cliches, glassmorphism, stock-photo gloss, or gamified trading-app styling.
Don't communicate market direction through color alone; every red/green value carries its sign.
Don't add a second display font, gradient text, side-stripe borders, or decorative card shadows.
Don't leak internal vocabulary (price_crosses_above, "Instrument #1", "SQLite-backed") into user-facing copy.
Don't ship manual refresh buttons; data updates in the background and announces its age only when degraded.
